headline.purpose: Workspace titles and major panel headers.

label.purpose: Badges, status bar, navigation labels, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Reserved for isolated repeated cards or transient surfaces.

motion.name: state-only
motion.purpose: Use only for state changes; no decorative page choreography.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Compact neutral action button for product workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 12px; background: #FCFCFD; color: #101828; border: 1px solid #E9ECF1; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: #F7F8FA; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0EA5A4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dense input field for filters, paths, and connection data.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 30px; padding: 4px 7px; background: #FCFCFD; color: #101828; border: 1px solid #E9ECF1; border-radius: 4px; font: 400 14px/1.45 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0EA5A4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Neutral Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 5px 10px; background: #F7F8FA; color: #101828; border: 1px solid #E9ECF1; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 224px; min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: #101828; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F7F8FA; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0EA5A4; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-item kbd { color: #667085; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Data Grid
components.description: Dense inspection table for monitoring and history.
components.css: .ds-grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #E9ECF1; color: #101828; font: 400 14px/1.45 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-grid th { height: 30px; color: #667085; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #E9ECF1; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-grid td { height: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E9ECF1; padding: 0 8px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Small operational metric card, never a hero metric.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width: 150px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #FCFCFD; border: 1px solid #E9ECF1; border-radius: 6px; color: #101828; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric span { display: block; color: #667085; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-metric small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #667085; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Firebird Admin is a dense and calm product interface for database administration. It should feel like a trustworthy control panel: measured, legible, and ready for repeated technical work without theatrical visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: Dense operational surfaces with clear scan paths.
Segoe UI throughout, with no display-font flourish.
Cool tinted neutrals with a rare teal accent for focus and primary state.
Tables, badges, forms, and status bars over marketing-style composition.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is rare. If teal starts decorating the screen, the interface has stopped being a control panel.

rules.name: The Native Tool Rule
rules.body: Use Segoe UI everywhere. Do not introduce display fonts, brand fonts, or decorative type into product controls.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: A workspace is not a card. Use full-page structure for work areas and reserve cards for repeated metrics, details, and modals.

dos: Do keep product screens dense, calm, and predictable.
Do keep teal rare and functional.
Do preserve DataGrid virtualization whenever grids can grow.
Do use visible keyboard focus on every interactive control.
Do prefer full-width workspace structure over floating page cards.
Do keep copy Portuguese-first until a localization plan says otherwise.
donts: Don't use hero metrics, marketing layouts, or landing-page composition inside the app.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, decorative gradients, or blurred cards.
Don't use colored side stripes as status indicators.
Don't introduce display fonts or decorative icons into operational UI.
Don't use semantic colors for decoration.
Don't hide dangerous or administrative state behind vague copy.
